x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Update set 1: HRSD_Security_<client>_v1 (Human Resources: Core) - Restricted HR service settings, any justified ACL additions Update set 2: HRSD_Services_<client>_v1 (Human Resources: Core) - COEs/topic categories/topic details/HR services, HR templates - Record producers, matching rules, SLA definitions, HR criteria Update set 3: HRSD_Lifecycle_<client>_v1 (Human Resources: Lifecycle Events) - Activity sets, activities, lifecycle event services Update set 4: HRSD_EmployeeCenter_<client>_v1 (global / Employee Center scope) - Taxonomy, branding, dashboards, survey triggers Data (not update sets): group memberships, HR profiles, knowledge articles. Note: group role grants (sys_group_has_role) are captured in update sets — review them before completing. Tip: use a batch update set parent so the four promote together.
